wrap_autoreset: wrap a gym environment with AutoReset to automatically reset when an episode is done
wrap_actionrepeat: wrap a gym environment with ActionRepeat to repeat the same action for multiple consecutive steps
wrap_randomstart: wrap a gym environment with RandomStart to perform random actions at the start of each episode
wrap_framehistory: wrap a gym environment with FrameHistory to augment observations with a ring buffer of past frames
wrap_externalprocess: wrap a gym environment with ExternalProcess to step it in a separate multiprocessing process
